verdict.rationale: Loops publishes an API reference with authentication guidance and endpoint listings (POST /events/send, POST /contacts/create, Guardian checks). A probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, which could drive interactive tooling. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser interactive playground, runnable or copyable request examples, and independent hands-on confirmation of the reference experience.
